description: No clean concept found. It fires mid to late game for one side to move, loosely when the centre column alternates me/them, my stones sit centrally on the second row, and column 5 is low with a threat directly above its landing cell; filling that cell turns it off. Hand-built threat-above-landing positions do not fire.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most about 0.04 (slightly lowers the centre column).
notes: Tried: col3 full/poisoned (F1 .09), any threat directly above a landing cell (F1 .07), hand-picked cell-occupancy and column-parity scores (best F1 .176, AUROC .59, simulation share -0.08). Minimal pairs show distant-cell interactions, e.g. needs both X(0,0) and O(0,5) in one early position. Clean constructed threat-above-landing positions do not fire. Probably distributed, polysemantic or a random direction.
